plan: Drive: from District of Tumbler Ridge, about 67 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.43495, -121.08061, pull off on Puggins Rp - K (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 3.0 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 2 m, about 60 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2008 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-21, Region 7B. Season: mule deer 4 point bucks Nov 1 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 62, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AF-deer-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-21: about 4,188 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.62 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

R7AF-grouse-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Puggins Rp - K (gravel road)

evidence.t: Trail: Paradise Valley trail, 5.5 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
7 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
3 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

plan: Drive: from District of Tumbler Ridge, about 68 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.441, -121.06336, pull off on Puggins Rp - K (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 40 m to the start. Walk: the Paradise Valley trail stretch, 5.5 km one way. About 111 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-21, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
